```python
def two_sum(nums, target):
    """返回和为 target 的两个下标。"""
    pairs = sorted((v, i) for i, v in enumerate(nums))
    lo, hi = 0, len(pairs) - 1
    while lo < hi:
        s = pairs[lo][0] + pairs[hi][0]
        if s == target:
            i, j = pairs[lo][1], pairs[hi][1]
            return [min(i, j), max(i, j)]
        if s < target:
            lo += 1
        else:
            hi -= 1
    return []

# 测试用例
def test_two_sum():
    assert two_sum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9) == [0, 1], "Test case 1 failed"
    assert two_sum([3, 2, 4], 6) == [1, 2], "Test case 2 failed"
    assert two_sum([3, 3], 6) == [0, 1], "Test case 3 failed"
    assert two_sum([-1, 2, 1, -4], 0) == [1, 2], "Test case 4 failed"
    assert two_sum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 10) == [4, 5], "Test case 5 failed"

test_two_sum()
```
